svg.title: Experiment Results
svg.desc: Experiment Results: Overall treatment effect +0.0342 across 4 intersections (p=0.0650). The effect is not significant. Heterogeneous effects were detected across subgroups. (severity: HIGH)

The effect is not significant. Heterogeneous effects were detected across subgroups.", "recommendation": "Inspect heterogeneous subgroups before rollout; a benefit on average can hide harm to a group."}
svg.text: FOREST PLOT: EFFECT SIZES WITH 95% CONFIDENCE INTERVALS
A/B test results with per-intersection treatment effects and confidence intervals. A significant overall
effect plus detected heterogeneity means the treatment affects subgroups differently. Overall treatment
effect +0.0342 across 4 intersections (p=0.0650). The effect is not significant. Heterogeneous effects
